name: Georg Friedrich Haas: 11,000 Strings
description: The 2026 MaerzMusik festival opens with a monumental piece by Georg Friedrich Haas: 11,000 Strings, performed by Klangforum Wien on 50 pianos inside MaHalla, a former factory hall in Oberschöneweide. This immersive microtonal concert installation challenges traditional listening habits and the relationship between stage and audience, offering an extraordinary sonic experience that questions what music is and why.
